about: Post-quantum stage of each chain on the site. Stage rules: docs/stages.md. Network results are written by scripts/patrol.py to data/network.json.

stage_basis.en: BIP-360 and BIP-361 are merged into the BIPs repository as Draft. Neither adds a post-quantum signature, so stage 3 needs one on a test network.
stage_basis.zh: BIP-360 和 BIP-361 已以草案状态合并进 BIPs 库。两者都不含抗量子签名，要到 3 档，得先有抗量子签名进入测试网。

algo.en: None yet. BIP-360 hides keys but adds no signature
algo.zh: 暂无；BIP-360 只隐藏公钥，不含签名方案

holder_can_use_today.en: No post-quantum signature exists. The only lever is exposure: unused P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH and P2WSH addresses keep the public key off-chain until it is first revealed, while P2PK outputs, reused addresses and Taproot (bc1p) outputs already expose it (BIP-360 exposure table).
holder_can_use_today.zh: 没有抗量子签名。目前唯一的办法是不让公钥上链：从未转出过的老式地址（1、3、bc1q 开头）在第一次转出前公钥不会公开；P2PK 输出、重复使用的地址和 Taproot（bc1p 开头）地址，公钥已经在链上（见 BIP-360 的暴露情况表）。

note.en: Stage 2 rests on BIP-360 and BIP-361 being merged as Draft. Neither is a post-quantum signature, so Bitcoin cannot move past stage 2 until a post-quantum signature reaches a test network.
note.zh: 2 档的依据是 BIP-360 和 BIP-361 已以草案状态合并。两者都不是抗量子签名，所以在抗量子签名进入测试网之前，比特币不会超过 2 档。

today.en: No. Bitcoin has no post-quantum signature on mainnet, on a test network or in a merged proposal. Its stage 2 comes from two Draft BIPs that prepare a migration.
today.zh: 没有。比特币的主网、测试网和已合并的提案中都没有抗量子签名。评为 2 档，是因为有两份为迁移做准备的 BIP 草案。

watch.en: Some coins already show their public key on-chain: old P2PK outputs, reused addresses and Taproot (bc1p) outputs. BIP-360 would add an output type that keeps the key hidden, but it is not a signature scheme.
watch.zh: 部分币的公钥已经暴露在链上：早期的 P2PK 输出、重复使用的地址，以及 Taproot（bc1p 开头）输出。BIP-360 会新增一种隐藏公钥的输出类型，但它不是签名方案。

can.en: Coins in a P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH or P2WSH address that has never been spent from keep their public key off-chain. Not reusing addresses keeps it that way.
can.zh: 存放在 P2PKH、P2SH、P2WPKH 或 P2WSH 地址、且从未转出过的币，公钥不在链上。不重复使用地址，就能保持这种状态。

next.en: A post-quantum signature proposal getting a BIP number, or BIP-360 code reaching Bitcoin Inquisition's signet. Either is the next step toward stage 3.
next.zh: 抗量子签名提案获得 BIP 编号，或 BIP-360 的代码进入 Bitcoin Inquisition 的 signet 测试网。任何一项实现，都是迈向 3 档的下一步。

latest_step.text: BIP-361 (phased sunset of old signatures) merged as Draft. No proposal has moved up a step since then; BIP-362 (exposure classes) is still an open pull request.
latest_step.zh: BIP-361（分阶段停用旧签名）以草案状态合并，此后没有提案再前进一步。BIP-362（公钥暴露分级）仍未合并。

milestones.name: BIP-360 Pay-to-Merkle-Root (P2MR): new output type without Taproot's key path, so the public key is not exposed while coins sit. Adds no post-quantum signature.
milestones.zh: BIP-360 P2MR（支付到默克尔根）：一种不带 Taproot 密钥路径的新输出类型，币在存放期间不暴露公钥。本身不含抗量子签名。

status.en: Draft (merged into the BIPs repository; latest version 0.12.1)
status.zh: 草案（已合并进 BIPs 库，最新版本 0.12.1）

milestones.name: BIP-361 Post Quantum Migration and Legacy Signature Sunset: Phase A bars sending to vulnerable outputs 160,000 blocks (~3 years) after activation; Phase B restricts ECDSA/Schnorr spends to a rescue protocol 2 years later.
milestones.zh: BIP-361 抗量子迁移与旧签名停用：A 阶段在激活后第 160,000 个区块（约 3 年）起，禁止向易受攻击的输出转账；B 阶段再过 2 年，用 ECDSA/Schnorr 签名转出只能走救援协议。

milestones.name: BIP-362 Output Public Key Exposure Classification (four classes; no consensus change)
milestones.zh: BIP-362 输出公钥暴露分级（分四级，不改共识）

milestones.name: BIP-360 implementation in Bitcoin Core (PR #33163)
milestones.zh: BIP-360 在 Bitcoin Core 中的实现（PR #33163）

milestones.name: Bitcoin Inquisition 29.4 (the signet test client for proposed soft forks) does not include BIP-360
milestones.zh: Bitcoin Inquisition 29.4（在 signet 测试网上试验软分叉提案的客户端）未收录 BIP-360

milestones.name: Post-quantum signature candidates (e.g. SHRINCS) discussed on Delving Bitcoin; none has a BIP number
milestones.zh: Delving Bitcoin 论坛在讨论抗量子签名候选方案（如 SHRINCS），均无 BIP 编号

stage_basis.en: EIP-8051 (ML-DSA) and EIP-8052 (Falcon-512) verification precompiles are merged into the EIPs repository as Draft. No public testnet lets holder accounts sign with them yet.
stage_basis.zh: EIP-8051（ML-DSA）和 EIP-8052（Falcon-512）验签预编译已以草案状态合并进 EIPs 库，但还没有公开测试网让持币人账户用它们签名。

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing at the protocol level.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 协议层暂无。

note.en: About ten client teams build post-quantum consensus clients from the EF's leanSpec (pq.ethereum.org). That work covers validator signatures, not holder accounts, so it does not count toward stage 3.
note.zh: 约十个客户端团队正依据基金会的 leanSpec（pq.ethereum.org）开发抗量子共识客户端。这项工作针对验证者签名，不涉及持币人账户，因此不计入 3 档。

today.en: No. Ethereum accounts still sign with secp256k1 on mainnet. Its stage 2 comes from Draft EIPs for ML-DSA and Falcon verification.
today.zh: 没有。以太坊主网账户仍使用 secp256k1 签名。评为 2 档，依据是 ML-DSA 和 Falcon 验签的 EIP 草案。

watch.en: Post-quantum work on consensus clients covers validator signatures, not your account. The Foundation's December 2029 target is a plan and is not rated.
watch.zh: 共识客户端上的抗量子工作针对的是验证者签名，与你的账户无关。基金会 2029 年 12 月的目标只是计划，不参与评档。

can.en: There is nothing to switch on at the protocol level yet. Post-quantum wallets offered today are third-party code and are not counted here.
can.zh: 协议层目前没有可以启用的功能。市面上的抗量子钱包都是第三方代码，不计入档位。

next.en: An activation date for the Hegotá upgrade, which lists EIP-8141 (Frame Transaction) as Scheduled for Inclusion, and whether EIP-8051 or EIP-8052 is scheduled too.
next.zh: Hegotá 升级确定激活日期（EIP-8141 帧交易已列为「计划纳入」），以及 EIP-8051 或 EIP-8052 是否也被排进去。

latest_step.text: EIP-8141 (Frame Transaction), which gives accounts a native way to move off secp256k1 keys, is listed as Scheduled for Inclusion in the Hegotá upgrade. No activation date has been set.
latest_step.zh: EIP-8141（帧交易，让账户可以原生弃用现有的 secp256k1 密钥）已列为 Hegotá 升级的「计划纳入」项，尚无激活日期。

milestones.name: EIP-8051 precompile for ML-DSA signature verification
milestones.zh: EIP-8051：ML-DSA 验签预编译

milestones.name: EIP-8052 precompile for Falcon-512 signature verification
milestones.zh: EIP-8052：Falcon-512 验签预编译

milestones.name: EIP-8141 Frame Transaction (account abstraction; route away from secp256k1 keys)
milestones.zh: EIP-8141 帧交易（账户抽象，让账户可以弃用 secp256k1 密钥）

status.en: Draft; Scheduled for Inclusion in Hegotá per EIP-8081; no activation date
status.zh: 草案；EIP-8081 将其列为 Hegotá「计划纳入」；尚无激活日期

milestones.name: Ethereum Foundation post-quantum roadmap hub (fork milestones I*, J*, L*, M*; no dates per fork)
milestones.zh: 以太坊基金会抗量子路线图页面（分叉里程碑 I*、J*、L*、M*，各分叉未标日期）

status.zh: 已发布；页面于 2026-06-27 更新

milestones.name: EF Protocol cluster target: L1 quantum-resistant across all three layers by December 2029, to be reassessed in January 2027
milestones.zh: 基金会协议组目标：2029 年 12 月前让 L1 三个层面全部抗量子，2027 年 1 月重新评估

milestones.name: About ten client teams build post-quantum consensus clients from the EF's leanSpec. This covers validator signatures, not holder accounts, so it does not count toward stage 3.
milestones.zh: 约十个客户端团队正依据基金会的 leanSpec 开发抗量子共识客户端。这项工作针对验证者签名，不涉及持币人账户，因此不计入 3 档。

stage_basis.en: BNB Chain has published a migration study, and its post-quantum proposals BEP-713 and BEP-736 are still open pull requests. Nothing is merged.
stage_basis.zh: BNB Chain 发布了迁移研究，抗量子提案 BEP-713 和 BEP-736 仍是未合并的拉取请求。

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 暂无。

note.en: The report does not say whether the tests ran on a private testbed or a public network, and no post-quantum feature is on BSC testnet or mainnet.
note.zh: 测试报告没有说明测试是在私有环境还是公开网络上进行；BSC 的测试网和主网上都没有抗量子功能。

latest_step.text: BEP-736 (ML-DSA-44 and SLH-DSA verification precompiles) opened as a pull request. The migration roadmap BEP-713 is still unmerged.
latest_step.zh: BEP-736（ML-DSA-44 和 SLH-DSA 验签预编译）已提交，尚未合并；迁移路线图 BEP-713 也未合并。

milestones.name: BSC post-quantum migration report: ML-DSA-44 for transactions and votes, pqSTARK aggregation; cross-region transfer ceiling fell from 4,973 to 2,997 TPS in tests
milestones.zh: BSC 抗量子迁移报告：交易和投票使用 ML-DSA-44，用 pqSTARK 聚合签名；测试中跨地区转账上限从 4,973 TPS 降到 2,997 TPS

milestones.name: Proof-of-concept code (bsc PR #3660, 'post quantum migration poc')
milestones.zh: 概念验证代码（bsc PR #3660「post quantum migration poc」）

milestones.name: BEP-713 Post-Quantum Cryptography Migration Roadmap for BSC (Information; four phases)
milestones.zh: BEP-713 BSC 抗量子密码迁移路线图（信息类，分四个阶段）

milestones.name: BEP-736 Post-Quantum Signature Verification Precompiles
milestones.zh: BEP-736 抗量子签名验证预编译

stage_basis.en: Ripple has published a post-quantum roadmap, and a Dilithium key type is merged only into rippled's experimental alphanet branch, not into a release.
stage_basis.zh: Ripple 发布了抗量子路线图；Dilithium 密钥类型只合并进 rippled 的实验分支 alphanet，没有进入正式版本。

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing on mainnet.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 主网暂无。

note.en: No post-quantum XLS proposal from the core developers exists in XRPLF/XRPL-Standards as of the check date.
note.zh: 截至核对日，XRPLF/XRPL-Standards 中没有核心开发者提出的抗量子 XLS 提案。

latest_step.text: An ML-DSA (Dilithium) key type was merged into the experimental 'alphanet' branch of rippled. It is not in the main development branch, and there is no XLS standard for it.
latest_step.zh: ML-DSA（Dilithium）密钥类型已合并进 rippled 的实验分支 alphanet，未进入主开发分支，也没有对应的 XLS 标准。

milestones.name: Ripple's four-phase post-quantum roadmap; Phase 4 (native post-quantum signatures via a new amendment) targets 2028
milestones.zh: Ripple 的四阶段抗量子路线图；第 4 阶段（通过新修正案引入原生抗量子签名）目标为 2028 年

status.en: Roadmap from Ripple (a company), target not rated
status.zh: Ripple 公司的路线图，目标不参与评档

milestones.name: Dilithium key type merged into the 'alphanet' branch of XRPLF/rippled
milestones.zh: Dilithium 密钥类型合并进 XRPLF/rippled 的 alphanet 分支

status.en: Prototype code on an experimental branch
status.zh: 实验分支上的原型代码

claim.en: AlphaNet, a public developer network, runs quantum accounts and transactions with ML-DSA.
claim.zh: 公开开发者网络 AlphaNet 正在运行使用 ML-DSA 的量子账户和交易。

reason.en: AlphaNet is not listed in the official XRPL documentation, and the endpoints we found are run by a third party. The code exists on a branch, but we could not confirm who operates the network or what it runs.
reason.zh: 官方 XRPL 文档中没有 AlphaNet，我们找到的接入点由第三方运营。代码确实在分支上，但无法确认网络由谁运营、运行的是什么。

stage_basis.en: Anza's Falcon implementation is an open draft pull request in solana-sdk, and the Falcon syscall proposal SIMD-0461 was closed without merge.
stage_basis.zh: Anza 的 Falcon 实现在 solana-sdk 中仍是未合并的草案拉取请求；Falcon 系统调用提案 SIMD-0461 已关闭，未合并。

algo.zh: Falcon（提案已关闭）；哈希方案（研究中）

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing at the protocol level. Third-party open-source vault code that locks SOL behind hash-based one-time signatures exists (blueshift-gg/solana-winternitz-vault); it is not a Solana feature and is not counted.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 协议层暂无。有第三方开源的保险库代码，用基于哈希的一次性签名锁定 SOL，但这不是 Solana 的官方功能，不计入档位。

note.en: If the Project Eleven testnet is confirmed as a public Solana testnet with post-quantum accounts, Solana would move to stage 3.
note.zh: 如果 Project Eleven 的测试网被确认是支持抗量子账户的 Solana 公开测试网，Solana 将升至 3 档。

latest_step.text: Anza published Quantumglow, a research design for post-quantum consensus. The Falcon syscall proposal SIMD-0461 was closed without merge on 2026-06-17.
latest_step.zh: Anza 发布抗量子共识研究设计 Quantumglow。Falcon 验签提案 SIMD-0461 已于 2026 年 6 月 17 日关闭，未合并。

milestones.name: SIMD-0461 Falcon signature verification as a syscall
milestones.zh: SIMD-0461：以系统调用形式提供 Falcon 签名验证

milestones.name: Firedancer native Falcon verification (PR #9446); closed with the note that Falcon as an on-chain program is viable
milestones.zh: Firedancer 原生 Falcon 验证（PR #9446）；关闭时注明，Falcon 以链上程序形式实现是可行的

milestones.name: Anza Falcon implementation in solana-sdk (PR #537)
milestones.zh: Anza 在 solana-sdk 中的 Falcon 实现（PR #537）

milestones.name: Quantumglow: post-quantum version of Alpenglow consensus using a hash-based scheme
milestones.zh: Quantumglow：Alpenglow 共识的抗量子版本，采用基于哈希的方案

status.zh: 研究（没有 SIMD，也没有测试网）

milestones.name: Winternitz vault program (third party)
milestones.zh: Winternitz 保险库程序（第三方）

status.en: Open-source code; not a protocol feature; not counted
status.zh: 开源代码；不是协议功能，不计入档位

claim.en: Project Eleven, working with the Solana Foundation, deployed post-quantum signatures on a Solana testnet (December 2025).
claim.zh: Project Eleven 与 Solana 基金会合作，在一个 Solana 测试网上部署了抗量子签名（2025 年 12 月）。

reason.en: The Project Eleven and Solana Foundation pages blocked automated access, and press coverage says the signature scheme was not disclosed. We could not confirm that this is the public Solana testnet.
reason.zh: Project Eleven 和 Solana 基金会的页面拦截了自动访问，媒体报道称签名方案未公开。无法确认这就是 Solana 的公开测试网。

stage_basis.en: Falcon-512 is switched on in the Nile testnet's chain parameters, so holders can sign with it there. Mainnet has no post-quantum parameter.
stage_basis.zh: Nile 测试网的链参数已启用 Falcon-512，持币人可以在测试网上用它签名；主网链参数中没有抗量子选项。

algo.en: Falcon-512 on in testnet; ML-DSA-44 built, off
algo.zh: Falcon-512 已在测试网启用；ML-DSA-44 已实现，未启用

holder_can_use_today.en: Not on mainnet. On the Nile testnet, Falcon-512 signatures are switched on; ML-DSA-44 is implemented but not yet switched on.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 主网暂无。Nile 测试网已启用 Falcon-512 签名；ML-DSA-44 已实现，尚未启用。

note.en: Press reports of a Q3 2026 mainnet launch did not happen: the mainnet API shows no post-quantum parameter on the check date.
note.zh: 媒体所说的 2026 年第三季度上主网并未发生：核对当日，主网接口中没有抗量子参数。

today.en: Not on mainnet. TRON is the only top-ten chain where you can sign with a post-quantum key on an official public testnet: Falcon-512 is switched on in Nile.
today.zh: 主网没有。TRON 是市值前十中唯一能在官方公开测试网上用抗量子密钥签名的链：Nile 测试网已启用 Falcon-512。

watch.en: Mainnet chain parameters show no post-quantum switch, and press reports of a Q3 2026 mainnet launch did not come true. TIP-899 is still a Draft.
watch.zh: 主网链参数中没有抗量子开关；媒体所说的 2026 年第三季度上主网并未发生。TIP-899 仍是草案。

can.en: Developers can try Falcon-512 accounts on the Nile testnet. Mainnet holders have no post-quantum option yet.
can.zh: 开发者可以在 Nile 测试网上试用 Falcon-512 账户。主网持币人目前没有抗量子选项。

next.en: The independent review that TIP-899's author called planned but not confirmed, then a mainnet governance proposal that switches Falcon-512 on.
next.zh: TIP-899 作者所说「已在计划中，但尚未确定」的独立审计，以及之后在主网启用 Falcon-512 的治理提案。

latest_step.text: TIP-899 is still Draft. Its author wrote that an independent review before activation is 'planned but not yet confirmed'. Mainnet chain parameters show no post-quantum switch.
latest_step.zh: TIP-899 仍是草案。作者表示，启用前的独立审计「已在计划中，但尚未确定」。主网链参数中没有抗量子开关。

milestones.name: TIP-899 Post-Quantum Signature Support (Falcon-512 and ML-DSA-44; off by default; each switched on by its own governance proposal)
milestones.zh: TIP-899 抗量子签名支持（Falcon-512 和 ML-DSA-44；默认关闭；各需一项治理提案单独启用）

milestones.name: First Nile testnet build with post-quantum signatures (GreatVoyage-Nile-v4.8.2-PQ1-build1); latest PQ build v4.8.2.4-PQ1 on 2026-10-23
milestones.zh: 首个支持抗量子签名的 Nile 测试网版本（GreatVoyage-Nile-v4.8.2-PQ1-build1）；最新的 PQ 版本 v4.8.2.4-PQ1 于 2026-10-23 发布

milestones.name: Nile chain parameters: getAllowFnDsa512 = 1 (Falcon-512 on), getAllowMlDsa44 unset (off)
milestones.zh: Nile 链参数：getAllowFnDsa512 = 1（Falcon-512 已启用），getAllowMlDsa44 未设置（未启用）

milestones.name: Mainnet: no post-quantum parameter in chain parameters; latest mainnet release GreatVoyage-v4.8.2.4 has no post-quantum changes
milestones.zh: 主网：链参数中没有抗量子参数；最新主网版本 GreatVoyage-v4.8.2.4 不含抗量子改动

milestones.name: TIP-899's author writes that an independent review before activation is planned but not yet confirmed.
milestones.zh: TIP-899 作者表示，启用前的独立审计「已在计划中，但尚未确定」。

stage_basis.en: No post-quantum research, roadmap or proposal appears in Hyperliquid's documentation or its GitHub organization.
stage_basis.zh: Hyperliquid 的官方文档和 GitHub 组织中，都没有抗量子研究、路线图或提案。

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing. Accounts are EVM wallets and actions are signed with EIP-712.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 暂无。账户是以太坊式钱包，操作用 EIP-712 签名。

note.en: A stage 0 rating reflects only what is public. It is not a judgement of the team's internal plans.
note.zh: 0 档只反映公开信息，不代表对团队内部计划的判断。

latest_step.text: No public post-quantum research or proposal. The full official documentation does not mention quantum, and the hyperliquid-dex GitHub organisation has no related issues or code.
latest_step.zh: 没有公开的抗量子研究或提案。官方文档全文未提及「量子」，GitHub 组织中也没有相关议题或代码。

milestones.name: Official documentation: no mention of quantum; signing uses EIP-712
milestones.zh: 官方文档：没有提到量子；签名使用 EIP-712

milestones.name: hyperliquid-dex GitHub organisation: no post-quantum issues or code
milestones.zh: hyperliquid-dex GitHub 组织：没有抗量子相关议题或代码

claim.en: A third-party vendor offers a Falcon-based vault for HYPE holders in early access.
claim.zh: 一家第三方厂商为 HYPE 持有人提供基于 Falcon 的保险库，目前处于抢先体验阶段。

reason.en: Vendor claim in press coverage only. Not reviewed, and it would not count as a chain feature.
reason.zh: 只有媒体转述的厂商说法，未经审查；即使属实，也不算链本身的功能。

note.en: No public node repository found
note.zh: 未找到公开的节点代码库

stage_basis.en: ZIP 2005 is Final and NU6.3 moved new shielded funds into the recoverable Ironwood pool on mainnet. The post-quantum Recovery Protocol is not specified yet, and recoverability alone tops out at stage 2.
stage_basis.zh: ZIP 2005 已定稿，NU6.3 已在主网把新的隐私资金转入可恢复的 Ironwood 池。抗量子恢复协议尚未制定，而「资金可恢复」最高只评 2 档。

algo.zh: 恢复协议，规范尚未写出

holder_can_use_today.en: Groundwork only. Since 2026-07-28, new shielded funds go into the Ironwood pool, whose notes are built so that a future post-quantum Recovery Protocol can return them. That protocol is not yet specified, so this is not post-quantum protection today. Funds left in the Sprout, Sapling or Orchard pools would not be recoverable.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 目前只是铺垫。自 2026 年 7 月 28 日起，新的隐私资金进入 Ironwood 池，待将来的抗量子「恢复协议」推出后可以恢复；该协议尚未写出规范，所以今天还不算保护。留在 Sprout、Sapling 或 Orchard 池中的资金将来无法恢复。

note.en: Zcash is the only chain in this table with a quantum-related consensus change live on mainnet. It is capped at stage 2 because recoverability is not a post-quantum way to spend. The 2026-07-28 activation date is the timestamp of block 3,428,143 on a public block explorer.
note.zh: Zcash 是本表中唯一在主网上线了量子相关共识改动的链。由于「可恢复」并不是抗量子的转账方式，最高只评 2 档。2026-07-28 这个激活日期，取自公开区块浏览器上第 3,428,143 号区块的时间戳。

latest_step.text: The NU6.3 network upgrade activated on mainnet at block 3,428,143, bringing in ZIP 2005 (Ironwood quantum recoverability). The wallet migration guide, ZIP 318, is still Draft.
latest_step.zh: NU6.3 网络升级在第 3,428,143 号区块激活，带来 ZIP 2005（Ironwood 量子可恢复性）。钱包迁移指南 ZIP 318 仍是草案。

milestones.name: ZIP 2005 Ironwood Quantum Recoverability ('does not by itself make the protocol secure against quantum adversaries')
milestones.zh: ZIP 2005 Ironwood 量子可恢复性（原文称其「本身并不能让协议抵御量子攻击者」）

milestones.name: ZIP 258 NU6.3 deployment: mainnet activation height 3,428,143; after activation no new value may enter the Orchard pool, so new shielded value goes to Ironwood
milestones.zh: ZIP 258 NU6.3 部署：主网激活高度 3,428,143；激活后新资金不能再进入 Orchard 池，新的隐私资金改为进入 Ironwood 池

milestones.name: ZIP 318 Orchard to Ironwood Migration (wallet best practices)
milestones.zh: ZIP 318 从 Orchard 迁移到 Ironwood（钱包最佳实践）

milestones.name: Recovery Protocol (the actual post-quantum spend path)
milestones.zh: 恢复协议（真正的抗量子转账路径）

status.zh: ZIP 2005 中有概述，尚未写出规范

stage_basis.en: Falcon-512 and Dilithium2 exist only in the libdogecoin library and in a draft proposal without a number. Nothing is in Dogecoin Core.
stage_basis.zh: Falcon-512 和 Dilithium2 只存在于 libdogecoin 库和一份没有编号的草案提案中，Dogecoin Core 里没有。

consensus.zh: 工作量证明（与莱特币合并挖矿）

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing that protects funds. The experimental post-quantum 'commitments' written into OP_RETURN outputs are consensus-neutral by design, so coins are still spent with ECDSA alone.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 没有能保护资金的功能。写入 OP_RETURN 的实验性抗量子「承诺」按设计不改变共识，币仍只靠 ECDSA 签名保护。

note.en: The draft states it 'can be adapted to a DIP process if/when a formal DIP track is preferred'. Until it enters the dogecoin/dips track, it counts as a proposal (stage 1), not a merged spec.
note.zh: 草案称，如果日后更倾向于走正式的 DIP 流程，它「可以改写为 DIP」。在进入 dogecoin/dips 之前，它只算提案（1 档），不算已合并的规范。

latest_step.text: The Dogecoin Foundation's libdogecoin library merged further post-quantum tooling (liboqs linking and tests). Nothing has reached Dogecoin Core or a DIP.
latest_step.zh: 狗狗币基金会的 libdogecoin 库又合并了一批抗量子工具（liboqs 链接和测试）。尚未进入 Dogecoin Core，也没有 DIP。

milestones.name: Draft proposal 'Post-Quantum Signature Commitments' (Phase 1: OP_RETURN commitments, no consensus change; later: a soft-fork opcode); added to libdogecoin in PR #288
milestones.zh: 草案提案「抗量子签名承诺」（第 1 阶段：写入 OP_RETURN 的承诺，不改共识；之后：软分叉操作码），经 PR #288 加入 libdogecoin

status.en: Draft, no BIP or DIP number; lives in a library repository, not the formal DIP track
status.zh: 草案，没有 BIP 或 DIP 编号；存放在工具库中，不在正式 DIP 流程里

milestones.name: liboqs-based Falcon-512 and Dilithium2 support in libdogecoin (library layer; Raccoon-G added in PR #294)
milestones.zh: libdogecoin 基于 liboqs 支持 Falcon-512 和 Dilithium2（工具库层面；PR #294 加入 Raccoon-G）

status.en: Merged into the library, not into Dogecoin Core
status.zh: 已合并进工具库，未进入 Dogecoin Core

claim.en: The Dogecoin Foundation confirmed an experimental post-quantum transaction on mainnet (April 2026).
claim.zh: 狗狗币基金会确认在主网上完成了一笔实验性的抗量子交易（2026 年 4 月）。

reason.en: We did not retrieve the Foundation's own announcement. Either way, the draft describes such transactions as consensus-neutral, so they would not change the stage.
reason.zh: 没有拿到基金会的原始公告。无论是否属实，草案都把这类交易定为不改变共识，不影响档位。

stage_basis.en: Post-quantum signatures are open research topics in the Monero Research Lab (issues #159 and #151). There is no proposal or code for spending.
stage_basis.zh: 抗量子签名在 Monero 研究实验室仍是开放的研究议题（#159 和 #151），还没有针对花费的提案或代码。

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 暂无。

note.en: Carrot's quantum-related property concerns privacy (who paid whom), not protection of funds from theft, so it does not count toward the stage.
note.zh: Carrot 与量子相关的特性关乎隐私（谁付钱给谁），不涉及防止资金被盗，因此不计入档位。

latest_step.text: The Monero Research Lab opened a discussion on post-quantum spend signatures. The next upgrade (FCMP++ with Carrot addressing) adds some privacy protection against quantum observers but keeps elliptic-curve spend signatures, and it is not on mainnet yet.
latest_step.zh: 门罗研究实验室开启了抗量子转账签名的讨论。下一次升级（FCMP++ 加 Carrot 地址）能在隐私层面防范部分量子观察者，但转账签名仍基于椭圆曲线，且尚未上线主网。

milestones.name: Monero Research Lab issue #159: post-quantum signatures (notes that FCMP++ still uses classical signatures for spend authorisation)
milestones.zh: 门罗研究实验室议题 #159：抗量子签名（指出 FCMP++ 的转账授权仍使用传统签名）

milestones.name: Monero Research Lab issue #151: post-quantum encryption for the future Jamtis address scheme; describes Carrot's partial forward secrecy against a quantum adversary
milestones.zh: 门罗研究实验室议题 #151：为未来的 Jamtis 地址方案引入抗量子加密；介绍 Carrot 面对量子攻击者时的部分前向保密

milestones.name: FCMP++/Carrot upgrade: mainnet hard-fork table still ends at version 16; latest release v0.18.5.4 (2026-10-17)
milestones.zh: FCMP++/Carrot 升级：主网硬分叉表仍止于第 16 版；最新版本 v0.18.5.4（2026-10-17）

stage_basis.en: Falcon-512 signature chains are available on mainnet as an opt-in. Classical Brainpool keys stay valid.
stage_basis.zh: 主网已可选用 Falcon-512 签名链，传统的 Brainpool 密钥仍然有效。

consensus.zh: 工作量证明 + 权益证明

holder_can_use_today.en: Opt-in Falcon-512; classical Brainpool signatures remain valid. Signature chains commit to a subsequent key and scheme.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 可选用 Falcon-512；传统的 Brainpool 签名仍然有效。签名链会预先承诺下一把密钥及其方案。

note.en: Do not treat every Nexus account as post-quantum.
note.zh: 并非所有 Nexus 账户都抗量子。

latest_step.text: Latest node release 5.1.6. Falcon-512 stays opt-in; classical Brainpool keys remain valid.
latest_step.zh: 最新节点版本 5.1.6。Falcon-512 仍为可选，传统的 Brainpool 签名依然有效。

note.en: Commits are spread over two branches
note.zh: 提交分布在两个分支上

stage_basis.en: Three Falcon-512 account classes are declared on Starknet mainnet, and a holder can deploy an account with one. Every Starknet account is a contract, so an account class counts here (see the account-contract rule); these classes come from OpenZeppelin (pre-release) and S2morrow, not from StarkWare or the Starknet Foundation, and none is audited.
stage_basis.zh: Starknet 主网上已声明 3 个 Falcon-512 账户类，持币人可以用其中之一部署账户。Starknet 的每个账户本身就是合约，所以账户类在这里计入档位（见「账户即合约」规则）；这些账户类来自 OpenZeppelin（预发布版）和 S2morrow，不是 StarkWare 或 Starknet 基金会发布的，都没有经过审计。

algo.zh: Falcon-512 账户合约；STARK 证明

consensus.zh: 以太坊 L2 · 正逐步引入权益证明

holder_can_use_today.en: A holder can deploy an account from one of 3 Falcon-512 account classes declared on mainnet (OpenZeppelin pre-release or S2morrow; none audited). Ordinary accounts use Stark-curve ECDSA. Starknet's validity proofs are STARKs, which rest on hash functions.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 持币人可以用主网上已声明的 3 个 Falcon-512 账户类之一部署账户（OpenZeppelin 预发布版或 S2morrow，都未经审计）。普通账户使用 Stark 曲线 ECDSA。Starknet 的有效性证明是基于哈希函数的 STARK。

note.en: The Falcon account classes are pre-release and unaudited, cost far more gas than ECDSA accounts, and existing accounts must move to them one by one. Ethereum settlement and bridge dependencies remain.
note.zh: 这些 Falcon 账户类是预发布版、未经审计，手续费远高于 ECDSA 账户，现有账户要逐个迁移过去。以太坊结算和跨链桥的依赖仍在。

latest_step.text: Three Falcon-512 account classes are declared on mainnet. No audit is published for the cheapest one (S2morrow).
latest_step.zh: 三种 Falcon-512 账户合约已在主网上线。其中 gas 最低的 S2morrow 没有公开审计报告。

milestones.name: OpenZeppelin Contracts for Cairo v4.1.0-rc.0, a pre-release, adds Falcon-512 account components and presets. Falcon is verified in Cairo contract code, not by a protocol builtin.
milestones.zh: OpenZeppelin Contracts for Cairo 预发布版 v4.1.0-rc.0 加入 Falcon-512 账户组件和预设。Falcon 验签写在 Cairo 合约代码里，不是协议内置功能。

milestones.name: Checked on mainnet: the Starknet feeder gateway returns the declared Falcon-512 account class from OpenZeppelin; two more Falcon classes (OpenZeppelin direct, S2morrow) are declared too.
milestones.zh: 主网核对：Starknet feeder gateway 能查到已声明的 OpenZeppelin Falcon-512 账户类；另有两个 Falcon 账户类（OpenZeppelin direct 版、S2morrow）也已声明。

stage_basis.en: Since consensus version 42, mainnet accepts native Falcon-1024 accounts: a holder can rekey to a Falcon address and sign with Falcon. Ordinary Ed25519 accounts remain the default.
stage_basis.zh: 自共识版本 42 起，主网接受原生 Falcon-1024 账户：持币人可以把账户换绑到 Falcon 地址并用 Falcon 签名。普通 Ed25519 账户仍是默认。

algo.en: Falcon-1024 accounts (deterministic variant, opt-in); Falcon State Proofs
algo.zh: Falcon-1024 账户（确定性变体，可自选）；Falcon 状态证明

holder_can_use_today.en: Native Falcon-1024 accounts are live on mainnet as an opt-in (since consensus version 42), and Falcon also signs State Proofs. Ordinary Ed25519 accounts remain the default.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 主网已上线原生 Falcon-1024 账户，可自选（自共识版本 42 起）；Falcon 也用于签署状态证明。普通 Ed25519 账户仍是默认。

note.en: State Proofs and account signing have different roles. Consensus participation keys remain classical; app and wallet support still matters.
note.zh: 状态证明和账户签名是两回事。共识参与密钥仍使用传统算法；还需要钱包和应用支持。

latest_step.text: go-algorand v5.1.1 adds Falcon-512 next to Falcon-1024 and a post-quantum LogicSig scheme. No protocol upgrade yet.
latest_step.zh: go-algorand v5.1.1 在 Falcon-1024 之外新增 Falcon-512，以及用于 LogicSig 的抗量子方案。尚未包含协议升级。

milestones.name: algod v5.0.0 ships consensus version 42, which enables native Falcon-1024 accounts (EnablePQSchemeFalcon1024). Mainnet now runs version 43, which keeps them.
milestones.zh: algod v5.0.0 带来共识版本 42，启用原生 Falcon-1024 账户（EnablePQSchemeFalcon1024）。主网现在运行的版本 43 沿用了这项功能。

stage_basis.en: A SPHINCS+ lock script is deployed on mainnet. Holders opt in by moving coins into it.
stage_basis.zh: SPHINCS+ 锁定脚本已部署在主网上，持币人把币转入即可选用。

holder_can_use_today.en: An opt-in SPHINCS+ spending lock. New verification logic can be deployed as lock scripts.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 可选用的 SPHINCS+ 锁定脚本。新的验签逻辑可以作为锁定脚本部署。

note.en: Existing cells must satisfy their old spending rules before migration. Default secp256k1 cells do not change automatically.
note.zh: 已有的 cell 必须先按原规则转出才能迁移；默认使用 secp256k1 的 cell 不会自动切换。

latest_step.text: SPHINCS+ lock deployed on mainnet. Existing coins must be moved into it to be covered.
latest_step.zh: SPHINCS+ 锁定脚本已上主网。已有的币需自行转入才受保护。

stage_basis.en: Every mainnet transfer is signed with multivariate Rainbow or UOV keys by default. That older Rainbow parameters are publicly broken is shown in the algorithm labels.
stage_basis.zh: 主网每笔转账默认使用多变量 Rainbow 或 UOV 密钥签名。旧版 Rainbow 参数已被公开破解，这一点标在算法标签里。

holder_can_use_today.en: RainbowPro and UOV configurations; multisig is a separate capability. Key configuration selects the signing scheme. Existing keys do not change automatically.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 可选 RainbowPro 和 UOV 配置；多签是另一项功能。签名方案由密钥配置决定，已有密钥不会自动更换。

note.en: The guide lists Rainbow configuration 274 as the default. Legacy ABCMint Rainbow parameters have a public break. New configurations require separate analysis; NIST UOV candidate parameters are not Raqcoin deployment parameters.
note.zh: 使用指南将 Rainbow 配置 274 列为默认。ABCMint 的旧版 Rainbow 参数已被公开破解；新配置需另行分析；NIST 的 UOV 候选参数并非 Raqcoin 的实际部署参数。

latest_step.text: Last commit to the community client repository. The original repository last changed 2025-10-13.
latest_step.zh: 社区客户端代码库的最后一次提交。原始代码库最后一次改动在 2025-10-13。

stage_basis.en: Every mainnet transfer is signed with WOTS+ one-time signatures.
stage_basis.zh: 主网每笔转账都使用 WOTS+ 一次性签名。

holder_can_use_today.en: WOTS+ transaction signatures. One active signing scheme in the reviewed material.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 交易使用 WOTS+ 签名。核查资料中只有这一种在用的签名方案。

note.en: Consensus changed; the signing scheme remained WOTS+. No claim that a future protocol upgrade could never change it.
note.zh: 共识机制变了，签名方案仍是 WOTS+。

latest_step.text: Consensus moved from proof of work to proof of stake. Signing stays WOTS+.
latest_step.zh: 共识机制由工作量证明改为权益证明，签名仍为 WOTS+。

stage_basis.en: Every QRL 1.x mainnet account has signed with XMSS since launch in June 2018.
stage_basis.zh: QRL 1.x 主网的所有账户自 2018 年 6 月上线起就使用 XMSS 签名。

holder_can_use_today.en: XMSS transaction signatures. Hash-function choice and descriptor fields; not arbitrary switching between signature families.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 交易使用 XMSS 签名。可选择哈希函数并设置描述字段，但不能在不同签名族之间随意切换。

note.en: XMSS is stateful: each address can sign a limited number of times, and a one-time key index must never be reused.
note.zh: XMSS 是有状态签名：每个地址可签名的次数有限，一次性密钥序号不能重复使用。

today.en: Yes, by default. Every QRL 1.x mainnet account signs with XMSS, a hash-based scheme, and has since launch in June 2018.
today.zh: 有，默认启用。QRL 1.x 主网的所有账户自 2018 年 6 月上线起，就使用基于哈希的 XMSS 签名。

watch.en: XMSS is stateful. Each address can sign a fixed number of times, and a one-time key index must never be used twice, so the wallet has to keep track.
watch.zh: XMSS 是有状态签名：每个地址可签名的次数固定，一次性密钥序号绝不能重复使用，钱包必须记录用到了哪一个。

can.en: Use a wallet that tracks the one-time key index, and check how many signatures your address has left before it runs out.
can.zh: 使用能记录一次性密钥序号的钱包，并在次数用完前查看地址还剩多少次签名。

next.en: QRL 2.0, which moves to NIST's ML-DSA and proof of stake. It is on Testnet V2, and the project says mainnet depends on audits and has no date.
next.zh: QRL 2.0 将改用 NIST 的 ML-DSA 和权益证明，目前处于测试网 V2。项目方表示主网上线取决于审计，尚未定日期。

latest_step.text: Node v4.0.13 keeps legacy XMSS compatibility and improves fork recovery.
latest_step.zh: 节点 v4.0.13 保留对旧版 XMSS 的兼容，并改进分叉恢复。

milestones.name: QRL mainnet launches. Every account signs with XMSS, a hash-based scheme.
milestones.zh: QRL 主网上线，所有账户都使用基于哈希的 XMSS 签名。

milestones.name: XMSS implementation in the QRL node, with a choice of hash functions (code pinned to a commit).
milestones.zh: QRL 节点中的 XMSS 实现，可选择哈希函数（代码固定到具体提交）。

milestones.name: QRL 2.0 public devnet pre-release.
milestones.zh: QRL 2.0 公开开发网预发布。

milestones.name: QRL 2.0 Testnet V1 goes live.
milestones.zh: QRL 2.0 测试网 V1 上线。

milestones.name: QRL 2.0 Testnet V2 launches as the audit-ready public testnet. QRL 2.0 signs transactions and validator duties with NIST's ML-DSA and moves to proof of stake.
milestones.zh: QRL 2.0 测试网 V2 上线，是一个已具备审计条件的公开测试网。QRL 2.0 的交易和验证者职责改用 NIST 的 ML-DSA 签名，共识改为权益证明。

milestones.name: Pull request #1824 merged: keeps legacy XMSS compatibility and makes fork recovery more robust.
milestones.zh: PR #1824 合并：保留对旧版 XMSS 的兼容，分叉恢复更稳健。

milestones.name: QRL node v4.0.13 released with that change.
milestones.zh: QRL 节点 v4.0.13 发布，包含上述改动。

milestones.name: QRL 2.0 mainnet: no date set. The project says launch depends on external audits.
milestones.zh: QRL 2.0 主网：尚未定日期。项目方表示，上线取决于外部审计结果。

milestones.name: Network check: QRL 1.x mainnet block #4,442,254 at 11:32 UTC, 1 min before the check.
milestones.zh: 网络核查：QRL 1.x 主网最新区块为第 4,442,254 号，UTC 11:32 出块，距核查 1 分钟。

stage_basis.en: Falcon-512 signs every mainnet transfer.
stage_basis.zh: 主网每笔转账都使用 Falcon-512 签名。

algo.en: Falcon-512; ML-DSA in upgrade code (not active)
algo.zh: Falcon-512；ML-DSA 已在升级代码中（未启用）

holder_can_use_today.en: Falcon-512 active; Falcon-1024 and ML-DSA exist in upgrade code. Multiple schemes are implemented behind an activation gate.
holder_can_use_today.zh: Falcon-512 已启用；Falcon-1024 和 ML-DSA 在升级代码中。多种方案已实现，但需达到激活条件才会启用。

note.en: Implemented upgrade support does not establish that it is active on mainnet.
note.zh: 升级代码中已实现，不代表主网已启用。

latest_step.text: Release candidate 4 for Tidecoin 1.0.0 (pre-release) fixes wallet fee estimates. 1.0.0 final is not out.
latest_step.zh: Tidecoin 1.0.0 第四个候选版本（预发布）修复了钱包手续费估算问题，1.0.0 正式版尚未发布。

stage_basis.en: Every mainnet transfer uses Abelian's lattice-based PQRingCT or PQRingCTX scheme.
stage_basis.zh: 主网每笔转账都使用 Abelian 自己的格密码方案 PQRingCT 或 PQRingCTX。

holder_can_use_today.en: Custom lattice-based PQRingCT/PQRingCTX schemes. Versioned cryptographic schemes; mining algorithm choice is a separate matter.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 自研的格密码方案 PQRingCT/PQRingCTX。密码方案带版本号；挖矿算法的选择是另一回事。

note.en: These schemes are not ML-DSA. Dual PoW does not mean PoW plus PoS. QDay is a separate L2.
note.zh: 这些方案不是 ML-DSA。双工作量证明不等于 PoW 加 PoS。

latest_step.text: Aconcagua upgrade: dual proof of work (ABEL-ETHash and ABEL-Nakamoto). Signing unchanged.
latest_step.zh: Aconcagua 升级：改为双工作量证明（ABEL-ETHash 和 ABEL-Nakamoto），签名方案不变。

stage_basis.en: The node creates Dilithium wallets by default (sig_dil in the wallet command), so native transfers are signed with a post-quantum scheme unless the holder picks another type.
stage_basis.zh: 节点默认创建 Dilithium 钱包（钱包命令中的 sig_dil），所以原生转账默认用抗量子签名，除非持币人另选签名类型。

consensus.zh: 权益证明 + 权威证明

holder_can_use_today.en: Native-wallet options include Dilithium, Falcon and SPHINCS+. Multiple native signing schemes, subject to network and wallet support.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 原生钱包可选 Dilithium、Falcon 和 SPHINCS+，能用哪种取决于网络和钱包。

note.en: Scope is native CF-20 assets, not ERC-20/BEP-20 tokens. Picnic is a historical/deprecated route, not a current wallet option in this release. Shipovnik: the verifier flaw Fireblocks published on 2026-09-15 is still in the dap-sdk code, but the build files suggest current nodes do not compile Shipovnik in.
note.zh: 范围限于原生 CF-20 资产，不含 ERC-20/BEP-20 代币。Shipovnik：Fireblocks 于 2026-09-15 公布的验签漏洞仍在 dap-sdk 代码中，但从构建文件看，当前节点没有编译 Shipovnik。

latest_step.text: Last commit on the main branch of the public node mirror.
latest_step.zh: 公开节点镜像主分支的最后一次提交。

milestones.name: The node's wallet command creates a Dilithium wallet (sig_dil) unless another signature type is chosen; Falcon, SPHINCS+ and others are options.
milestones.zh: 节点的钱包命令默认创建 Dilithium 钱包（sig_dil），也可以另选 Falcon、SPHINCS+ 等签名类型。

claim.en: Cellframe mainnet is producing blocks today
claim.zh: Cellframe 主网今天仍在出块

reason.en: scan.cellframe.net and cellframe.net did not open from our checker on 2026-11-27; the code repositories were updated on 2026-11-26.
reason.zh: 2026-11-27 我们的核查环境打不开 scan.cellframe.net 和 cellframe.net；代码仓库 2026-11-26 仍有更新。

no_probe_reason.en: No public block API found; scan.cellframe.net timed out on 2026-11-27.
no_probe_reason.zh: 没有找到公开的出块接口；2026-11-27 访问 scan.cellframe.net 超时。

note.en: Releases are not published on GitHub
note.zh: 未在 GitHub 上发布版本

stage_basis.en: Mainnet transfers use hybrid signatures by default: ML-DSA or SLH-DSA together with Ed25519.
stage_basis.zh: 主网转账默认使用混合签名：ML-DSA 或 SLH-DSA 搭配 Ed25519。

algo.zh: ML-DSA / SLH-DSA 与 Ed25519 混合签名

holder_can_use_today.en: Hybrid post-quantum and Ed25519 signing; ML-DSA and SLH-DSA components. Signing modes change at protocol thresholds and in emergency mode.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 抗量子签名与 Ed25519 混合签名，组件包括 ML-DSA 和 SLH-DSA。签名模式会在达到协议阈值时以及紧急模式下切换。

note.en: Do not assume every protocol phase uses exactly the same component combination. ML-KEM node handshakes are not transaction signatures. The pre-standard Dilithium and SPHINCS+ hybrid (with Ed25519) is still accepted, and was the default before block 3,426,263.
note.zh: 不同协议阶段的签名组合不一定相同。节点间的 ML-KEM 握手不是交易签名。标准化之前的 Dilithium 加 SPHINCS+ 混合签名（含 Ed25519）仍被接受，在区块 3,426,263 之前是默认方案。

latest_step.text: Node release test-v2.0.85, the latest commit to the main repository.
latest_step.zh: 节点版本 test-v2.0.85，也是主代码库的最后一次提交。

stage_basis.en: Mainnet spends are authorized by hash-preimage locks checked in STARK proofs, with no elliptic-curve signature.
stage_basis.zh: 主网的花费由哈希原像锁授权，并在 STARK 证明中验证，不使用椭圆曲线签名。

holder_can_use_today.en: Hash-preimage spending conditions and Triton STARK validity proofs. Programmable lock scripts.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 以哈希原像作为支出条件，并使用 Triton STARK 有效性证明。支持可编程锁定脚本。

note.en: A STARK proof and a hash-preimage spending condition are not a fixed-size standard digital signature.
note.zh: STARK 证明和哈希原像支出条件，都不是固定长度的标准数字签名。

latest_step.text: neptune-core v0.20.1 (build fix only).
latest_step.zh: neptune-core v0.20.1（仅修复构建）。

no_probe_reason.en: No public block API found; explorer.neptune.cash returned HTTP 502 on 2026-11-27.
no_probe_reason.zh: 没有找到公开的出块接口；2026-11-27 访问 explorer.neptune.cash 返回 502 错误。

stage_basis.en: Mainnet transfers have been signed with ML-DSA by default since launch on 9 September 2026.
stage_basis.zh: 主网自 2026-09-09 上线起，转账默认使用 ML-DSA 签名。

holder_can_use_today.en: ML-DSA-87 and ML-DSA-65 transaction signing. Parameter-set selection within ML-DSA.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 交易使用 ML-DSA-87 和 ML-DSA-65 签名。可在 ML-DSA 的参数集之间选择。

note.en: Mainnet accepts both ML-DSA-87 and ML-DSA-65 signatures; wallets default to ML-DSA-87. Quantus and qtcchain both use QTC but are separate chains.
note.zh: 主网同时接受 ML-DSA-87 和 ML-DSA-65 签名，钱包默认 ML-DSA-87。Quantus 和 qtcchain 都用 QTC 这个代号，但是两条不同的链。

latest_step.text: Node v1.0.5, a maintenance release. Mainnet launched 2026-09-09.
latest_step.zh: 节点 v1.0.5，维护版本。主网于 2026-09-09 上线。

milestones.name: Mainnet runtime accepts Dilithium87 and Dilithium65 (ML-DSA-87 and ML-DSA-65) signatures from the launch tag v1.0.0-gm onward.
milestones.zh: 主网运行时从上线版本 v1.0.0-gm 起就接受 Dilithium87 和 Dilithium65（即 ML-DSA-87 和 ML-DSA-65）签名。

stage_basis.en: Mainnet transfers are signed with ML-DSA-65 by default, with an SLH-DSA fallback leaf.
stage_basis.zh: 主网转账默认使用 ML-DSA-65 签名，另有 SLH-DSA 备用路径。

holder_can_use_today.en: ML-DSA-65 primary signing; SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s fallback leaves. Cross-family fallback requires committing to the alternative spending leaf in advance.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 主签名为 ML-DSA-65，备用分支为 SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s。跨签名族的备用路径需要事先承诺对应的支出分支。

note.en: This is not a claim that every spend carries both signatures or that a new fallback can be added after a key is compromised.
note.zh: 并非每笔交易都带两种签名；密钥泄露后也无法再补加备用路径。

latest_step.text: Node v31.99.1, no consensus change. Mainnet launched 2026-09-26.

stage_basis.en: Mainnet transfers are signed with ML-DSA-44 by default, with SLH-DSA as a fallback.
stage_basis.zh: 主网转账默认使用 ML-DSA-44 签名，SLH-DSA 作为备用。

holder_can_use_today.en: ML-DSA-44 primary signing; SLH-DSA fallback/multisig. Per-key scheme selection and multiple script leaves.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 主签名为 ML-DSA-44，SLH-DSA 用于备用和多签。每把密钥可单独选择方案，并支持多个脚本分支。

note.en: Falcon is reserved in the reviewed specification. qtcchain is unrelated to Quantus despite the shared QTC ticker. The repository records a v2 treasury allocation; inclusion is not a fair-launch endorsement.
note.zh: Falcon 在规范中仅为预留。与 Quantus 无关。代码库记录了 v2 金库分配；收录不代表我们认为其发行公平。

latest_step.text: v0.2.5 retired old peer versions from mainnet height 4,000. Mainnet consensus unchanged.
latest_step.zh: v0.2.5 从主网第 4,000 号区块起断开旧版本节点，主网共识不变。

stage_basis.en: Mainnet transfers are signed with ML-DSA-44 by default.
stage_basis.zh: 主网转账默认使用 ML-DSA-44 签名。

holder_can_use_today.en: ML-DSA-44 transaction signing. One active transaction-signing scheme in the snapshot.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 交易使用 ML-DSA-44 签名。核查时只有这一种在用的交易签名方案。

note.en: XMSS experiments are not counted as a mainnet signing path. Public blocks do not establish user adoption or independent security certification.
note.zh: XMSS 试验不算主网上的签名方式。公开出块不代表有用户采用，也不代表通过独立安全认证。

latest_step.text: v2.6.1. A chain-ID rule scheduled in 2.6.0 applies from block 67,000.
latest_step.zh: v2.6.1。2.6.0 设定的链 ID 规则自第 67,000 号区块起生效。

stage_basis.en: Official documentation says XLINK pairs ML-DSA-65 with secp256k1 on the public testnet, but no primary source (code or a checked transaction) confirms it, so the stage is capped at 2 as a stated plan.
stage_basis.zh: 官方文档说测试网上 XLINK 把 ML-DSA-65 和 secp256k1 配对使用，但没有原始出处（代码或核对过的交易）能证实，所以按「官方说法」最高记 2 档。

holder_can_use_today.en: No post-quantum option on mainnet. The project documents ML-DSA-65 pairing (XLINK) on its testnet.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 主网没有抗量子选项。项目文档写了测试网上的 ML-DSA-65 配对（XLINK）。

note.en: The traded QANX token does not establish a live native post-quantum mainnet. The original 2024 announcement used the Dilithium name; do not backdate current parameters.
note.zh: QANX 代币在交易，不代表原生抗量子主网已上线。2024 年最初的公告用的是 Dilithium 这个名字，不要把现在的参数往前套。

latest_step.text: Public testnet announced. The QANX token trades, but the post-quantum chain is still a testnet.
latest_step.zh: 宣布公开测试网。QANX 代币在交易，但抗量子链仍处于测试网阶段。

milestones.name: The public testnet RPC answers, but its newest block is from 2026-09-14. No post-quantum signed transaction was checked, and no node source code is public (the private-blockchain repository is a Docker wrapper).
milestones.zh: 公开测试网 RPC 能连上，但最新区块停在 2026-09-14。没有核对到抗量子签名的交易，节点源代码也没有公开（private-blockchain 仓库只是 Docker 封装）。

status.en: Testnet seen; post-quantum spends not confirmed
status.zh: 测试网存在，抗量子花费未核实

note.en: No public node repository found
note.zh: 未找到公开的节点代码库

chains.name: Bitcoin Cash

stage_basis.en: CHIP-2026-06, a draft self-published by Bitcoin Cash developers, proposes SPHINCS+, Falcon and hybrid signatures. No node release includes it.
stage_basis.zh: Bitcoin Cash 开发者自行发布的草案 CHIP-2026-06 提议加入 SPHINCS+、Falcon 和混合签名，目前没有节点版本包含它。

algo.en: None at protocol level. Draft CHIP-2026-06 proposes SPHINCS+ and Falcon; third-party Quantumroot vaults use LM-OTS (RFC 8554).
algo.zh: 协议层暂无。CHIP-2026-06 草案提议 SPHINCS+ 和 Falcon；第三方 Quantumroot 金库合约用 LM-OTS（RFC 8554）。

holder_can_use_today.en: No protocol-level post-quantum signature. Holders can lock coins in third-party Quantumroot vault contracts, which add a hash-based LM-OTS spending path next to the normal Schnorr key.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 协议层没有抗量子签名。持币人可以把币放进第三方 Quantumroot 金库合约：在普通 Schnorr 密钥之外，多一条基于哈希的 LM-OTS 花费路径。

note.en: Quantumroot is unaudited third-party code. Its author advised in December 2025 against putting real funds in it before an audited wallet exists, and the Electron Cash plugin asks users to stick to small amounts.
note.zh: Quantumroot 是未经审计的第三方代码。作者 2025 年 12 月表示，在有经过审计的钱包之前不宜存入真实资金；Electron Cash 插件也提示只用小额。

today.en: No protocol-level post-quantum signature. Holders can lock coins in third-party Quantumroot vault contracts, which add a hash-based LM-OTS spending path next to the normal Schnorr key.
today.zh: 协议层没有抗量子签名。持币人可以把币放进第三方 Quantumroot 金库合约：在普通 Schnorr 密钥之外，多一条基于哈希的 LM-OTS 花费路径。

watch.en: Quantumroot is unaudited third-party code. Its author advised in December 2025 against putting real funds in it before an audited wallet exists, and the Electron Cash plugin asks users to stick to small amounts.
watch.zh: Quantumroot 是未经审计的第三方代码。作者 2025 年 12 月表示，在有经过审计的钱包之前不宜存入真实资金；Electron Cash 插件也提示只用小额。

can.en: Try a Quantumroot vault with small amounts (developer-preview contracts, prototype Electron Cash plugin), or keep standard addresses and follow CHIP-2026-06.
can.zh: 可以小额试用 Quantumroot 金库（开发者预览版合约、Electron Cash 原型插件），或者继续用普通地址，关注 CHIP-2026-06 的进展。

next.en: Whether node teams take CHIP-2026-06 into a network upgrade. Activation on chipnet, BCH's upgrade test network, would mean stage 3.
next.zh: 节点团队是否把 CHIP-2026-06 纳入网络升级。若在 BCH 的升级测试网 chipnet 上激活，即到 3 档。

latest_step.text: A prototype Electron Cash plugin for Quantumroot vaults was published; it is developer-tested only and unaudited.
latest_step.zh: Quantumroot 金库的 Electron Cash 原型插件发布，仅经开发者测试，未经审计。

milestones.name: May 2025 upgrade activates the VM Limits and BigInt CHIPs. VM Limits names post-quantum cryptography among the uses of larger stack items; no post-quantum signature is added.
milestones.zh: 2025 年 5 月升级激活 VM Limits 和 BigInt 两个 CHIP。VM Limits 把抗量子密码列为放宽栈元素上限的用途之一，但没有新增抗量子签名。

status.en: Activated on mainnet; general VM change
status.zh: 已在主网激活；通用虚拟机改动

milestones.name: Quantumroot published by bitjson: a vault contract in CashAssembly with a Schnorr path and an LM-OTS (RFC 8554) quantum path.
milestones.zh: bitjson 发布 Quantumroot：用 CashAssembly 写的金库合约，一条 Schnorr 路径，一条 LM-OTS（RFC 8554）抗量子路径。

status.en: Developer preview; third-party contract, not counted
status.zh: 开发者预览版；第三方合约，不计入档位

milestones.name: Quantumroot vaults run on chipnet, BCH's upgrade preview network, with contracts, tests and transaction-generation code.
milestones.zh: Quantumroot 金库在 BCH 升级预览网 chipnet 上运行，合约、测试和交易生成代码一并公开。

milestones.name: Forum proposal 'Quantum-Resistant Bitcoin Cash: A Challenge-Based Transition Protocol': commit now, reveal later, and move coins to a quantum-resistant address; needs a new consensus rule.
milestones.zh: 论坛提案「Quantum-Resistant Bitcoin Cash: A Challenge-Based Transition Protocol」：先承诺、后揭示，把币迁到抗量子地址；需要新增共识规则。

milestones.name: May 2026 upgrade activates the Loops, Functions, P2S and Bitwise CHIPs (BCHN v29.0.0), the building blocks Quantumroot needs. No post-quantum signature opcode is added.
milestones.zh: 2026 年 5 月升级激活 Loops、Functions、P2S、Bitwise 四个 CHIP（BCHN v29.0.0），即 Quantumroot 依赖的组件；没有新增抗量子签名操作码。

status.en: Activated on mainnet; general VM change
status.zh: 已在主网激活；通用虚拟机改动

milestones.name: CHIP-2026-06 'Post-Quantum and Hybrid Signatures' (v0.1 draft): a public key's first byte selects the scheme, starting with SPHINCS+ and secp256k1 + post-quantum hybrids, spendable from ordinary P2PKH outputs; cites a Bitcoin Cash Node prototype.
milestones.zh: CHIP-2026-06「Post-Quantum and Hybrid Signatures」（v0.1 草案）：用公钥首字节选择签名方案，先上 SPHINCS+ 以及 secp256k1 加抗量子的混合签名，可从普通 P2PKH 输出花费；文中提到 Bitcoin Cash Node 原型。

status.en: Self-published draft under discussion; not in any BCHN release
status.zh: 作者自行发布的草案，讨论中；未进入任何 BCHN 版本

milestones.name: Prototype Electron Cash plugin for Quantumroot vaults; developer-tested only, unaudited, small amounts only.
milestones.zh: Quantumroot 金库的 Electron Cash 原型插件；仅经开发者测试，未经审计，只建议小额使用。

status.zh: 第三方钱包原型；不计入档位

claim.en: Press release (2026-05-26): OPTN and Paytaca wallets support Quantumroot vaults on mainnet, on Android and iOS.
claim.zh: 新闻稿（2026-05-26）称 OPTN 和 Paytaca 钱包已在主网支持 Quantumroot 金库，覆盖 Android 和 iOS。

reason.en: Community press release with no wallet versions and no audit; not checked against wallet release notes. Third-party wallets would not raise the stage anyway.
reason.zh: 社区新闻稿，没有给出钱包版本或审计信息，未与钱包发布说明核对；第三方钱包本来也不计入档位。

searched: upgradespecs.bitcoincashnode.org: 2025-05-15 and 2026-05-15 upgrade specs read; no post-quantum signature opcode; no 2027 upgrade listed

bitjson/bch-vm-limits, bch-bigint, bch-p2s, bch-loops, bch-functions, bch-bitwise READMEs grepped for quantum, Lamport, Winternitz, LM-OTS, SPHINCS: 'post-quantum' appears only as a motivation in VM Limits and Functions

gitlab.com/bitcoin-cash-node/bitcoin-cash-node (official; the GitHub repo is a mirror): merge requests and issues searched for 'quantum', 'post-quantum', 'sphincs', 'falcon' — none; release notes v28.0.1 to v29.2.0 (2026-10-01) checked
bitcoincashresearch.org search 'quantum' and 'CHIP-2026': CHIP-2026-06 (thread 1864, last post 2026-07-03), Quantumroot (1663), challenge-based transition (1804), plus general discussion threads
gitlab.com/mainnet-pat/chip-2026-06-generic-sigs README read (v0.1 draft, last repo activity 2026-08-09)
bitjson/quantumroot and fyookball/quantumroot-plugin READMEs read; GitHub issue/PR search 'quantumroot' in bitauth/libauth, paytaca/paytaca-app, Electron-Cash/Electron-Cash — none

chains.name: Litecoin

stage_basis.en: No post-quantum research, roadmap or proposal from Litecoin's core developers. A maintainer has only said the team is looking into it.
stage_basis.zh: Litecoin 核心开发者没有抗量子研究、路线图或提案；一位维护者只表示团队正在研究。

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing at the protocol level. MWEB, which is sometimes described as quantum resistant, still uses elliptic-curve keys and Schnorr signatures (LIP-0004).
holder_can_use_today.zh: 协议层没有。MWEB 有时被说成抗量子，但它仍用椭圆曲线密钥和 Schnorr 签名（LIP-0004）。

note.en: An official Litecoin post in November 2025 called MWEB addresses quantum resistant, but an MWEB address is a pair of elliptic-curve public keys and MWEB inputs are signed with Schnorr.
note.zh: Litecoin 官方账号 2025 年 11 月称 MWEB 地址抗量子，但 MWEB 地址由两把椭圆曲线公钥组成，MWEB 输入用 Schnorr 签名。

today.en: Nothing at the protocol level. MWEB, which is sometimes described as quantum resistant, still uses elliptic-curve keys and Schnorr signatures (LIP-0004).
today.zh: 协议层没有。MWEB 有时被说成抗量子，但它仍用椭圆曲线密钥和 Schnorr 签名（LIP-0004）。

watch.en: An official Litecoin post in November 2025 called MWEB addresses quantum resistant, but an MWEB address is a pair of elliptic-curve public keys and MWEB inputs are signed with Schnorr.
watch.zh: Litecoin 官方账号 2025 年 11 月称 MWEB 地址抗量子，但 MWEB 地址由两把椭圆曲线公钥组成，MWEB 输入用 Schnorr 签名。

can.en: No post-quantum option exists on Litecoin today.
can.zh: 目前 Litecoin 上没有抗量子选项。

next.en: A post-quantum LIP or code from the Litecoin core team (a maintainer said in September 2026 that they are looking into it).
next.zh: Litecoin 核心团队拿出抗量子 LIP 或代码（维护者 2026 年 9 月表示正在研究）。

latest_step.text: A Litecoin core maintainer replied on GitHub that the team is looking into it; no details or timeline.
latest_step.zh: Litecoin 核心维护者在 GitHub 上回复，团队正在研究这个问题；没有细节和时间表。

milestones.name: LIP-0003 (MWEB, Draft) says MimbleWimble will get an ElGamal switch commitment, to be activated by miner signaling if quantum computers become a threat, and that the implementation still needs discussion. It protects amount commitments, not holder keys.
milestones.zh: LIP-0003（MWEB，草案）提到 MimbleWimble 将带 ElGamal 切换承诺，量子计算机构成威胁时由矿工信号激活，并说明具体实现还要讨论。它保护的是金额承诺，不是持币人密钥。

milestones.name: Core maintainer on issue #1104 ('Quantum Security'): the team is looking into it.
milestones.zh: 核心维护者在议题 #1104（「Quantum Security」）下回复：团队正在研究。

status.en: Statement of intent; no public plan

milestones.name: litecoin-project/lips: no post-quantum LIP.
milestones.zh: litecoin-project/lips：没有抗量子 LIP。

claim.en: The official Litecoin account on X said MWEB addresses are quantum resistant (2025-11-23).
claim.zh: Litecoin 官方 X 账号称 MWEB 地址抗量子（2025-11-23）。

reason.en: Seen only through a news summary; the post gave no technical detail. Per LIP-0004, an MWEB address is a pair of elliptic-curve public keys and inputs are signed with Schnorr, so no post-quantum spend authorization is involved.
reason.zh: 只在新闻摘要中看到，原帖没有技术细节。按 LIP-0004，MWEB 地址是一对椭圆曲线公钥，输入用 Schnorr 签名，不涉及抗量子花费授权。

stage_basis.en: ML-DSA-65 keys have been live on mainnet since protocol version 85: any account can add one and sign transfers with it. Classical keys stay the default.
stage_basis.zh: ML-DSA-65 密钥自协议版本 85 起已在主网启用：任何账户都可以添加并用它签名转账，默认仍是传统密钥。

holder_can_use_today.en: A holder can add an ML-DSA-65 access key to an account and sign transactions with it; the official near-cli-rs can generate such keys.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 持币人可以给账户添加 ML-DSA-65 访问密钥，并用它签名交易；官方命令行工具 near-cli-rs 可以生成这类密钥。

note.en: Adding a post-quantum key does not remove the old ones: an Ed25519 or secp256k1 full-access key left on the account can still move the funds. Validator and block signatures are still Ed25519.
note.zh: 添加抗量子密钥不会删掉旧密钥：账户上只要还留着一把 Ed25519 或 secp256k1 完全访问密钥，就仍能用它转走资产。验证人和区块签名仍是 Ed25519。

can.zh: 用 near-cli-rs 添加 ML-DSA-65 完全访问密钥，再删掉传统密钥。协议版本 88 起，新的通用账户（0u…）可以由抗量子密钥派生。

algo.en: None yet (research favours Falcon for accounts)
algo.zh: 暂无（研究方向倾向用 Falcon 保护账户）

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing at the protocol level. DOT accounts sign with sr25519, ed25519 or ECDSA keys, and none of these is post-quantum.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 协议层面暂无。DOT 账户用 sr25519、ed25519 或 ECDSA 密钥签名，三者都不抗量子。

note.en: The only concrete account design, RFC #165, is an open draft, and its author writes that nothing can ship until NIST finalises FN-DSA (Falcon).
note.zh: 目前唯一具体的账户方案 RFC #165 还是未合并的草稿，作者本人写明在 NIST 定稿 FN-DSA（Falcon）之前无法上线。

today.en: Nothing at the protocol level. DOT accounts sign with sr25519, ed25519 or ECDSA keys, and none of these is post-quantum.
today.zh: 协议层面暂无。DOT 账户用 sr25519、ed25519 或 ECDSA 密钥签名，三者都不抗量子。

can.en: Nothing protocol-level today. Follow RFC #165 for the proposed hybrid account design.
can.zh: 目前协议层面没有可用的办法。可以关注 RFC #165 里的混合账户方案。

next.en: RFC #165 being merged into polkadot-fellows/RFCs, and NIST's final FIPS 206 (FN-DSA), which the RFC waits for.
next.zh: RFC #165 合并进 polkadot-fellows/RFCs；以及该 RFC 所等待的 NIST FIPS 206（FN-DSA）正式定稿。

stage_basis.en: The Web3 Foundation has published a post-quantum roadmap, and RFC #165 (hybrid Falcon accounts) is an open pull request. Nothing is merged or in polkadot-sdk.
stage_basis.zh: Web3 基金会发布了抗量子路线图，RFC #165（Falcon 混合账户）仍是未合并的拉取请求；polkadot-sdk 中还没有相关代码。

latest_step.text: The author of RFC #165 added notes on threshold Falcon schemes and on ML-DSA versus FN-DSA benchmarks. The RFC is still an open draft.
latest_step.zh: RFC #165 作者补充了门限 Falcon 方案以及 ML-DSA 与 FN-DSA 性能对比的备注。该 RFC 仍是未合并的草稿。

milestones.zh: Web3 基金会研究团队发布 Polkadot 与 JAM 的抗量子路线图：账户签名用 Falcon，其他环节用 ML-DSA，现有哈希函数继续沿用。

status.zh: 已发布路线图，未给日期

milestones.name: RFC #165 "Hybrid post-quantum accounts" opened by Web3 Foundation researcher Jeff Burdges: each account would pair a Falcon key with an ed25519 or sr25519 key.
milestones.zh: Web3 基金会研究员 Jeff Burdges 提交 RFC #165「混合抗量子账户」：每个账户在 ed25519 或 sr25519 密钥之外再配一把 Falcon 密钥。

milestones.name: Merged RFC texts in polkadot-fellows/RFCs and issues/PRs in paritytech/polkadot-sdk: no merged post-quantum change for accounts or consensus.
milestones.zh: polkadot-fellows/RFCs 已合并的 RFC 文本，以及 paritytech/polkadot-sdk 的 issue 和 PR：账户和共识都没有已合并的抗量子改动。

algo.zh: Cosmos SDK 已支持 ML-DSA-65（FIPS 204）；Cosmos Hub 尚未启用

note.zh: 按 SDK 文档，账户不能原地迁移：改用 ML-DSA 要新建账户再把资金转过去。允许账户换公钥的 PR（MsgChangePubKey）尚未合并。

today.en: Nothing on the Cosmos Hub. Accounts still sign with secp256k1; the ML-DSA-65 account keys in Cosmos SDK v0.55 reach ATOM holders only if the Hub upgrades to that SDK version.

holder_can_use_today.en: On mainnet, a Soroban contract account can now require an ML-DSA signature, since Protocol 30 added ML-DSA verification. Ordinary G… accounts and every transaction envelope still sign with Ed25519.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 主网上，Soroban 合约账户现在可以要求 ML-DSA 签名，因为 Protocol 30 加入了 ML-DSA 验证。普通 G… 账户和所有交易信封仍用 Ed25519 签名。

note.en: Protection exists only inside a custom contract account that someone has to write and deploy; no official ML-DSA account contract was found. A G… address is the Ed25519 public key itself, so classic accounts stay exposed until signer support arrives.
note.zh: 保护只存在于自定义合约账户里，合约得有人编写和部署，目前没找到官方的 ML-DSA 账户合约。G… 地址本身就是 Ed25519 公钥，在支持抗量子签名者之前，经典账户始终暴露在外。

today.zh: 主网上，Soroban 合约账户现在可以要求 ML-DSA 签名，因为 Protocol 30 加入了 ML-DSA 验证。普通 G… 账户和所有交易信封仍用 Ed25519 签名。

watch.en: Protection exists only inside a custom contract account that someone has to write and deploy; no official ML-DSA account contract was found. A G… address is the Ed25519 public key itself, so classic accounts stay exposed until signer support arrives.
watch.zh: 保护只存在于自定义合约账户里，合约得有人编写和部署，目前没找到官方的 ML-DSA 账户合约。G… 地址本身就是 Ed25519 公钥，在支持抗量子签名者之前，经典账户始终暴露在外。

can.en: Developers and wallets can build a Soroban custom account that checks ML-DSA signatures and hold XLM in it on mainnet. Ordinary users have no built-in option yet.
can.zh: 开发者和钱包可以编写校验 ML-DSA 签名的 Soroban 自定义账户，在主网上把 XLM 存进去。普通用户暂时没有内置选项。

next.en: The CAP that adds post-quantum signer types to classic G… accounts (stage 2 of SDF's Quantum Preparedness Plan, planned for 2027), and the signature-format discussion #2057 that prepares for it.
next.zh: 为经典 G… 账户加入抗量子签名者类型的 CAP（SDF 量子准备计划第二阶段，计划 2027 年），以及为此铺路的签名格式讨论 #2057。

stage_basis.en: CAP-0087 is implemented, and since Protocol 30 smart contracts on mainnet can verify ML-DSA signatures. Accounts still sign with Ed25519, and a contract account written by someone else does not count.
stage_basis.zh: CAP-0087 已实施，自协议版本 30 起主网合约可以验证 ML-DSA 签名；但账户仍使用 Ed25519 签名，他人编写的合约账户不计入档位。

latest_step.text: Protocol 30 activated on mainnet at ledger 65633432, putting CAP-0087's ML-DSA verification host functions live for Soroban contracts.

milestones.name: SDF publishes its Quantum Preparedness Plan: ML-DSA verification for Soroban contract accounts in 2026, a CAP adding post-quantum signers to classic G… accounts in 2027, and an Ed25519 cut-off whose timing depends on the threat. SCP validator signatures are to move in a separate upgrade.
milestones.zh: SDF 发布量子准备计划：2026 年为 Soroban 合约账户加入 ML-DSA 验证；2027 年用一项 CAP 让经典 G… 账户可添加抗量子签名者；停用 Ed25519 的时间视威胁而定。SCP 验证者签名另行升级。

milestones.zh: CAP-0087「ML-DSA 签名验证宿主函数」以草稿合并；2026-10-07 转为 Accepted，随后在 Protocol 30 中标为 Implemented。

algo.en: SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s-bounded30: a reduced-usage SLH-DSA profile (3,680-byte signatures, 2^30 signatures per key)
algo.zh: SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s-bounded30：限次使用的 SLH-DSA 变体（签名 3,680 字节，每把密钥最多 2^30 次签名）

consensus.zh: 工作量证明（PoW，SHA-256，支持 AuxPoW 合并挖矿）

holder_can_use_today.en: QBT sits in P2MR outputs that hide the spend key until first use, and every spend carries a hash-based SLH-DSA-family signature. There are no elliptic-curve spend paths on the launch chain.
holder_can_use_today.zh: QBT 存放在 P2MR 输出里，首次花费前不暴露花费公钥；每次花费都带一个基于哈希的 SLH-DSA 系签名。上线链上没有椭圆曲线花费路径。

note.en: The profile is not a FIPS 205 parameter set: FIPS 205 SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s signatures are 7,856 bytes, this one is 3,680 bytes and is designed for at most 2^30 signatures per key. The wallet tracks that limit per descriptor copy, so using one key in several wallets can exceed it.
note.zh: 这个参数集不是 FIPS 205 标准参数：标准 SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s 签名为 7,856 字节，这里只有 3,680 字节，每把密钥按设计最多只能签 2^30 次。钱包按每份描述符副本计数，同一把密钥放进多个钱包可能超限。

algo.en: Winternitz one-time signatures in a Merkle key tree (TreeKey; SHA3-256, w = 8)

holder_can_use_today.en: Every MINIMA coin is spent with a hash-based Winternitz signature from the owner's key tree; there is no elliptic-curve path. A default key allows 262,144 signatures (64 keys per level, 3 levels).
holder_can_use_today.zh: 每枚 MINIMA 都用持币人密钥树中的 Winternitz 哈希签名花费，没有椭圆曲线路径。默认密钥可签 262,144 次（每层 64 把密钥，共 3 层）。

note.en: Winternitz keys are one-time: reusing one weakens it, so the wallet must track which keys have been used (TreeKey keeps a use counter). The construction is the project's own combination of Winternitz signatures and a key tree, not a standardized scheme such as XMSS or LMS.
note.zh: Winternitz 密钥只能用一次：重复使用会削弱保护，所以钱包必须记录哪些密钥已经用过（TreeKey 有使用计数）。这套构造是项目自己把 Winternitz 签名和密钥树组合起来的，不是 XMSS、LMS 这类标准方案。

note.zh: ENA 是以太坊上 Ethena 协议的治理与质押代币；Converge（计划用 USDe/USDtb 付燃料费、验证者质押 ENA）查不到官方主网记录，Ethena 文档中也没有提到。

note.en: ONDO is the governance token of Ondo's tokenized-asset products on Ethereum; Ondo's July 2026 post says the Ondo Network is not a blockchain, so there is no chain of its own.
note.zh: ONDO 是 Ondo 代币化资产产品在以太坊上的治理代币；Ondo 2026 年 7 月的官方文章明确说 Ondo Network 并不是区块链，因此没有自己的主链。

note.en: ASTER is the token of the Aster exchange; on Aster Chain gas is zero per Aster's docs, and Phase 1 validators are run by the team (external validators not yet supported).
note.zh: ASTER 是 Aster 交易所的代币；按 Aster 官方文档，Aster Chain 上的燃料费为零，且第一阶段验证者由团队运行（尚不支持外部验证者）。

note.en: BGB is Bitget's exchange token; Morph's explorer still reports ETH as its native coin, and Morph's own post describes BGB as gas only in future tense.
note.zh: BGB 是 Bitget 的平台币；Morph 的区块浏览器仍以 ETH 为原生币，Morph 官方文章对 BGB 作燃料币也只是将来时。

note.en: PIEVERSE is a BEP-20/ERC-20 token of a payments project that runs on BNB Chain; it is not the gas or staking coin of its own network.
note.zh: PIEVERSE 是运行在 BNB Chain 上的支付项目的 BEP-20/ERC-20 代币，不是自有网络的燃料币或质押币。

note.en: Midnight pays fees in DUST, a resource that NIGHT generates, not in NIGHT itself, and block production is still run by federated node operators, so NIGHT neither pays fees nor secures consensus today.
note.zh: Midnight 用 NIGHT 生成的 DUST 付手续费，而不是 NIGHT 本身，且目前出块仍由联盟节点运营方负责，所以 NIGHT 现在既不付手续费，也不保护共识。

note.en: LIT is the staking and fee-discount token of the Lighter exchange; Lighter's docs describe no gas or consensus role for it.
note.zh: LIT 是 Lighter 交易所的质押与手续费折扣代币；Lighter 文档中没有它作燃料币或共识质押币的说明。
